title: Dragon's Breath Mead
description: Olda in Dragon Bridge wants someone to steal her husband Horgeir's hidden stash of Dragon's Breath Mead from a nearby cave. The mead can be returned to Olda for gold or to Horgeir for Block training.

base_facts: Olda lives in Dragon Bridge with her husband Horgeir.
Olda is fed up with Horgeir's drinking.

HEAR_OLDAS_COMPLAINT: Olda wants someone to steal Horgeir's hidden mead stash from a cave nearby guarded by wolves.
GIVE_MEAD_TO_OLDA: Olda received the Dragon's Breath Mead and rewarded the helper with gold.

base_facts: Horgeir owns the lumber mill in Dragon Bridge.
Horgeir promised his wife he would give up mead but secretly kept a stash.

HEAR_OLDAS_COMPLAINT: Horgeir has a secret stash of Dragon's Breath Mead hidden in a cave guarded by wolves.
GIVE_MEAD_TO_HORGEIR: Horgeir got his mead back and showed his friend how to block a punch from an angry spouse.
Player gives the mead to Horgeir instead for Block training, failing the original quest.

She will reward you with some gold, saying: "If my Horgeir doesn't give up the mead this time, I'll hit him over the head with it." You may instead choose to tell everything to Horgeir and return his favorite mead to.
If you talk to her about her husband, she will complain to you: "He promised me, swore on his ancestors, that he'd give up the mead.

beats.comment: Player learns about Horgeir's secret mead stash from Olda.
Player agrees to steal the mead for Olda, starting the quest.
Player finds and takes the Dragon's Breath Mead from the cave.
Player returns the mead to Olda for a gold reward.
Player gives the mead to Horgeir instead for Block training, failing the original quest.
